tasks.spec: Create a file named agy-smoke.txt in the current working directory. The file must contain exactly this text and nothing else: agy works with ringer
tasks.check: printf 'agy works with ringer' > expected.txt && diff -u expected.txt agy-smoke.txt
tasks.verified: The check proves agy created agy-smoke.txt with the exact requested content. Run via engines/run-agy-smoke.sh to wipe the workdir first — otherwise a previous successful run can leave a stale agy-smoke.txt that masks a new failure.
